summary: Investigated why the `ask_user` tool errored with 'no interactive UI is available' in a Gizmo session by probing the agent server's tool registry. Confirmed `ask_user` is present in the active tool list alongside other interactive tools (`input`, `remote_input`, `search`, etc.) loaded from the user's `~/.pi/agent/extensions` bundle, then located the registry-precedence code in `agent-session.js` and identified the user-side extension file (`ask-user.ts`) likely emitting that error message.
decisions: Probe tool list via a Node script (`probe-tools.mjs`) placed in the repo dir with an absolute Windows path, because `/tmp` is not reliably resolved by Windows-hosted Node/Python under git-bash.
errors: Earlier probe attempt failed to find `/tmp/probe-tools.mjs` because Python on Windows does not translate the git-bash `/tmp` path; resolved by writing the probe into the repo directory with a Windows-friendly absolute path.
